hook: An AI proved this speedrun can never be beaten

beats.say: Speedrunners beat the PICO-8 platformer Celeste Classic in 2,843 frames. Harmonic's Aristotle proved no one will ever do better.
It translated the game into Lean, a formal verification language, then pruned the search. In the hardest room it checked about 224 million states, over 100 orders of magnitude fewer than brute force.
In a one-dash category, it beat the 2,941-frame record with a 2,937-frame run, and proved that optimal too.
